items.q: The urine protein creatinine ratio (PCR) nephrotic-range cut-offs are:
items.exp: Urine PCR: adult ≥3000 mg/g; children ≥2000 mg/g. (Book p757)

items.q: Which statement about the urine PCR is TRUE as written?
opts: It is not diagnostic of nephrotic syndrome
It is the definitive diagnostic test of nephrotic syndrome
It replaces the 24-hour protein in all decisions
It is elevated only in minimal change disease
items.exp: Not diagnostic of nephrotic syndrome. (Book p757)

items.q: Nephrotic-range proteinuria is "also seen in" diabetes (m/c), 2° FSGS and amyloidosis; the treatment bracketed for this group is:
items.exp: Also seen in: diabetes (m/c), 2° FSGS, amyloidosis → Rx: ACE inhibitors, ARB. (Book p757)

items.q: In childhood nephrotic syndrome the edema compartment relationship written is:
items.exp: Proteinuria + hypoalbuminemia + edema; extravascular > intravascular. (Book p757)
